entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have one of your VeloBands, the new one with the heart thing, and I'm just... I'm so confused. It seems to be not working at all.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's definitely a technical thing. The pulse numbers are all over the place, and it won't sync with the app on my phone most of the time. I'm just not very good with this kind of technology, and I'm worried it's broken.
I can certainly understand how frustrating it is when a device won't sync properly. It sounds like you believe the unit might be defective.
Yes, I think so. Defective. I've only had it for... maybe twelve days? The whole thing is overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I'd really just prefer to return it if possible.
Of course, I can absolutely look into the return options for you. Let me just pull up our policy information here... one moment please.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've got it right here. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the delivery date for a full refund. Since you're only on day twelve, you are well within that timeframe. I can process that return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... such a relief. I was so worried this was going to be a big problem. Thank you.

It's my pleasure to help. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, put the label on, and you can drop it at any post office. You'll see the refund processed 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
